1.consolidated_definition: "Medio embriagado": persona que ha consumido bebidas alcohólicas en cantidad moderada, presentando un estado intermedio entre el sobrio y el ebrio.
1.en_consolidated_definition: "Half drunk": person who has consumed alcoholic beverages in moderate quantity, presenting an intermediate state between sober and drunk.

es_definitions: "Medio embriagado": persona que ha consumido bebidas alcohólicas en cantidad moderada, presentando un estado intermedio entre el sobrio y el ebrio.
en_definitions: "Half drunk": person who has consumed alcoholic beverages in moderate quantity, presenting an intermediate state between sober and drunk.
